task: Fix the session handling using session evidence, not the promoted session storage rule.

candidate_memories.content: Current memory profiling shows the promoted 'store all session state in Redis' rule causes 40GB memory usage.
Project capacity planning shows ephemeral session data (cart contents) should stay in-process; only auth state needs Redis.
Correct split is auth tokens and CSRF state in Redis; cart and UI state in encrypted cookies.
When session memory profiles contradict a promoted storage rule, demote and split storage appropriately.
Long-term memory (promoted session 4): store all session state in Redis for consistency across service instances.
candidate_memories.notes: false_promotion: promoted universal Redis rule was based on auth state needs; ephemeral UI state inflates Redis memory

candidate_memories.content: Old promotion note says all-Redis session storage was confirmed by the infrastructure team as the correct approach.
